people.name: Gadjin Masato Nagao 長尾雅人

relations.subject: Jonathan A. Silk
relations.object: Gadjin Masato Nagao 長尾雅人
relations.evidence: It is one of my greatest joys that now, more than twelve years after I first met him, I have again been able to study with Professor Nagao here in Kyoto. It is never possible to repay the kindness and affection of a Guru.

relations.subject: Jonathan A. Silk
relations.evidence: It is to Professor Nagao that I owe my first initiation into Buddhist Studies, my fortunate choice of Luis O. Gómez as a graduate advisor

relations.subject: Jonathan A. Silk
relations.evidence: My interest in the philological aspects of the Tibetan text of the Heart Sūtra dates to the time I first read the text, with Roger Jackson in my first years of Graduate School.
